result.title: Regularised RL improves sim-to-real transfer
result.comment: 9 pages of main-body content, with supporting details in the appendices. Under submission
result.summary: Regularised reinforcement learning (RL) has provable robustness guarantees that should ease the transfer of policies from simulation to robots, known as sim-to-real. Yet, weakly regularised algorithms like Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) remain the de facto choice in sim-to-real pipelines, while the practical benefits of regularisation for transfer remain poorly characterised. In this work, we study the sim-to-real performance of commonly used RL algorithms, with the aim of characterising the effects of regularisation on robotic performance. To that end, we derive Soft MellowMax Actor-Critic (SMM-AC), a novel regularised RL algorithm based on the soft mellowmax value function, which carries strong robustness guarantees. On MuJoCo continuous control benchmarks, SMM-AC is competitive with baselines like Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). On real robots, SMM-AC achieves higher return, while exhibiting greater robustness to perturbations in observations, the environment, and dynamics than baselines. Together, these results demonstrate that regularised RL improves real-world policy deployment through better robustness to the sim-to-real gap, and changing real-world conditions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文考察常用强化学习算法在 sim-to-real 迁移中的表现，并提出基于 soft mellowmax 值函数的正则化算法 SMM-AC，在 MuJoCo 与真机上比较回报及对观测、环境与动力学扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「正则化带来对观测扰动与分布偏移的鲁棒性保证」这一思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据受扰时 latent 状态稳定性与训练约束的问题，但与原论文主线相距较远、联系需人工判断。
